title: Google Search Ultimate Scraper Input Schema

queries.title: Search Queries / Keywords
queries.description: Keywords or search phrases to query on Google (supports search operators like site:, intitle:, filetype:).

countryCode.title: Country Code (gl)
countryCode.description: Two-letter country code for geo-targeted search results (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'fr', 'de', 'ae', 'sa', 'ca', 'au').

languageCode.title: Language Code (hl)
languageCode.description: Two-letter language code for search results (e.g. 'en', 'ar', 'fr', 'de', 'es').

maxResults.title: Maximum Results Per Query
maxResults.description: Maximum number of organic search results to extract per keyword.

resultsPerPage.title: Results Per Page (num)
resultsPerPage.description: Number of results requested per page from Google (10 to 100).

extractPaa.title: Extract People Also Ask (PAA)
extractPaa.description: If enabled, extracts questions and answers from Google's 'People Also Ask' interactive box.

extractRelated.title: Extract Related Searches
extractRelated.description: If enabled, extracts related search query suggestions at the bottom of the SERP.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (select GOOGLE_SERP or RESIDENTIAL group for reliable Google Search extraction without CAPTCHAs or SearchGuard blocks).
